items.title: 'Detestable, inexcusable, vile': AMC CEO slams Robinhood for tokenized stock offerings
items.summary: AMC (AMC) CEO Adam Aron slammed Robinhood (HOOD) for providing tokenized AMC stock on its platform without approval. Aron described it as "contemptible, outrageous, disgusting, detestable, inexcusable, vile" in a post on X. Watch the video above to learn more.

items.title: Coinbase Global (COIN) Adds Former X And xAI CFO To Its Board
items.summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS: COIN) has appointed Anthony Armstrong, former X Corp. and xAI chief financial officer, to its board of directors. Armstrong brings experience from investment banking roles at Morgan Stanley and senior finance positions at companies led by Elon Musk. His appointment adds board level expertise in high growth technology, large scale operations and government efficiency as Coinbase expands services, including in markets such as Canada.
